events.title: European Shares Seen Opening Up As Traders Shrug Off Fed Hike
events.description: European stocks are seen opening higher on Thursday after the U.S. Federal Reserve delivered its first interest-rate hike since July 2023 and suggested rates may need to go still higher to get inflation under control.

events.title: Indian Shares Edge Higher In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares eked out modest gains in cautious trade on Thursday as investors weighed a Federal Reserve's hawkish rate hike as well as tightening U.S. sanctions on Russian oil against falling crude oil prices in international markets.

events.title: Australian Market Trims Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is trimming its early gains in mid-market moves on Thursday, but extending the gains in the previous session, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving well above the 8,700 level, with gains in iron ore miners and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in gold miners, energy and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Higher
events.description: Asian markets are trading mostly higher on Thursday, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, amid a pullback of the surge in long-term bond yields after the US Fed delivered the first interest rate hike in more than three years since July 2023. Crude oil prices also pulled back on easing Middle East supply concerns amid reports of Saudi Arabia loading crude cargoes via Oman.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Little Changed At Open After Fed Rate Hike
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening little changed on Thursday as investors weigh a Federal Reserve's hawkish rate hike against falling oil prices.

events.title: Oversold Thai Stock Market Called Lower Again
events.description: The Thai stock market has moved lower in six straight sessions, retreating more than 55 points or 3.7 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,560-point plateau and it's expected to open under water again on Thursday.

events.title: No Help Yet For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in six straight sessions, sinking more than 250 points or 3.8 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 6,430-point plateau and it's likely to open lower again on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Modestly Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is trading modestly higher on Thursday, extending the gains in the previous session, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving well above the 64,000 mark, with gains in index heavyweights, automakers, exporters and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in technology stocks.

events.title: Hang Seng Likely To Remain Rangebound
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has moved higher in two of three trading days since the end of the five-day losing streak in which it had given up more than 850 points or 3 percent. The Hang Seng Index now sits just above the 24,710-point plateau although it's looking at a soft start on Thursday.

events.title: Soft Start Anticipated For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market on Wednesday ended the four-day losing streak in which it had slumped more than 85 points or 2.3 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,890-point plateau although it may face renewed selling pressure on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Higher
events.description: The Australian stock market is trading notably higher on Thursday, extending the gains in the previous session, despite the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving up to near the 8,750 level, with gains in iron ore miners and financial stocks partially offset by weakness in gold miners, energy and technology stocks.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market Poised To Open Under Water
events.description: The Taiwan stock market on Wednesday snapped the four-day losing streak in which it had dropped more than 1,650 points or 3 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just beneath the 45,850-point plateau although it may hand back those gains on Thursday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, sinking almost 85 points or 1.7 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,635-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the red again on Thursday.
